row.proto: int32_t (void *sponsors, uint32_t ctx, uint32_t team_key, void *sponsor)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Sums the goal rewards (goal+0x3c) of the sponsor goals selected by Career_SponsorGoal_SelectGoalListByModifier, multiplied by Game_SponsorGoal_FindIntGameValue when the goal has a value condition, adds a My Team scaling (sponsors+0x3a8->+0x368 float) for the player and passes each amount through Career_Sponsors_ScaleAmountByTeamModifier(reason 2). Returns the total goal income. Hook: total sponsor goal reward.

verify.notes: V9653 Sums goal+0x3c times FindIntGameValue over goals from SelectGoalListByModifier, scales by +0x3a8 -> +0x368 for player, then ScaleAmountByTeamModifier(reason 2).
